newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Five arrested in Irish journalist murder probe.
newsitem.headline: Five arrested in Irish journalist murder probe.

text.p: Irish police investigating the murder of crime reporter Veronica Guerin have arrested five more people, a police spokesman said on Friday.

The arrests bring to more than 100 the number of people detained for questioning since Guerin was killed by hitmen last June. Last week Paul Ward, 32, was charged with conspiracy to murder but he is the only person to have been charged so far.
Guerin specialised in exposing the activities of Dublin's drugs barons and police believe one of them ordered her murder.
The police spokesman said: "Five people were arrested in Cork city this morning as part of the ongoing investigation into criminal matters relating to the Veronica Guerin murder.
They will be held at different police stations for up to 48 hours for questioning, the spokesman added.
